verdict.rationale: Shopify's shipping product explicitly supports buying labels in bulk (up to 250 at once), and this is part of Shopify's admin/checkout ecosystem where carrier-calculated rates at checkout are a known standard feature, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of live carrier rate display at checkout or in-platform tracking/shipment status. missing for 10: explicit docs on live carrier rate calculation shown at checkout, and evidence of shipment tracking within the platform.
